883		// version name coinciding with "subscribe" is an ordinary identifier
884		// there, not the change-subscription keyword.
885		if inSessionSnapshotVersionsSubtree(segs) {
886			return false
887		}
888		for i, seg := range segs {
889			if seg != "subscribe" {
890				continue
891			}
892			// Identifier positions: sessionId (0) and documentId (2). A value of
893			// "subscribe" there is an ordinary identifier, not the endpoint word.
894			if i == 0 || i == 2 {
895				continue
896			}
897			// Endpoint keyword position: the fifth segment must be exactly
898			// "subscribe" with the documents/changes scaffolding around it, and no
899			// segment may follow. Any other occurrence is a malformed path.
900			if i == 4 && len(segs) == 5 &&
901				segs[0] != "" &&
902				segs[1] == "documents" &&
903				segs[2] != "" &&
904				segs[3] == "changes" {
905				return false
906			}
907			return true
908		}
909		return false
910	}

912	// malformedSessionCRDTPath reports whether p targets the session-scoped CRDT
913	// namespace but is not at one of its six exact locations:
914	//
915	//	POST /v1/sessions/{sessionId}/documents/{documentId}/crdt/ops
916	//	GET  /v1/sessions/{sessionId}/documents/{documentId}/crdt/state
917	//	POST /v1/sessions/{sessionId}/documents/{documentId}/crdt/compact
918	//	POST /v1/sessions/{sessionId}/documents/{documentId}/crdt/query
919	//	GET  /v1/sessions/{sessionId}/documents/{documentId}/crdt/list
920	//	GET  /v1/sessions/{sessionId}/documents/{documentId}/crdt/state/subscribe
921	//
922	// a missing "ops"/"state"/"compact"/"query"/"list"/"subscribe" segment, an extra
923	// segment, or a "crdt" segment in the keyword position (immediately past the
924	// document identifier) short of one of the registered shapes. ServeMux would
925	// answer those with a plain-text 404/405; every failure of these endpoints
926	// must be a JSON 400 instead. Empty segments are already rejected by the
927	// guard itself.
928	//
929	// "crdt" is treated as the endpoint keyword only in the fourth segment (index
930	// 3, right after the document identifier); a session or document identifier
931	// literally named "crdt" occupies an identifier position (index 0 or 2) and
932	// keeps its ordinary routes. Likewise "compact", "query" and "list" are
933	// endpoint keywords only in the fifth segment; a session or document literally
934	// named any of them is an ordinary identifier.
935	func malformedSessionCRDTPath(p string) bool {
936		rest, ok := strings.CutPrefix(p, "/v1/sessions/")
937		if !ok {
938			return false
939		}
940		segs := strings.Split(rest, "/")
941		if len(segs) < 4 || segs[1] != "documents" || segs[3] != "crdt" {
942			return false
943		}
944		// Keyword position reached. The batch commit, the state read, the
945		// compaction, the batch lookup and the ordered listing are all exactly
946		// {sessionId}/documents/{documentId}/crdt/{ops,state,compact,query,list};
947		// the subscription adds one trailing "subscribe" segment.
948		validOps := len(segs) == 5 &&
949			segs[0] != "" &&
950			segs[2] != "" &&
951			segs[4] == "ops"
952		validState := len(segs) == 5 &&
953			segs[0] != "" &&
954			segs[2] != "" &&
955			segs[4] == "state"
956		validCompact := len(segs) == 5 &&
957			segs[0] != "" &&
958			segs[2] != "" &&
959			segs[4] == "compact"
960		validQuery := len(segs) == 5 &&
961			segs[0] != "" &&
962			segs[2] != "" &&
963			segs[4] == "query"
964		validList := len(segs) == 5 &&
965			segs[0] != "" &&
966			segs[2] != "" &&
967			segs[4] == "list"
968		validSubscribe := len(segs) == 6 &&
969			segs[0] != "" &&
970			segs[2] != "" &&
971			segs[4] == "state" &&
972			segs[5] == "subscribe"
973		return !(validOps || validState || validCompact || validQuery || validList || validSubscribe)
974	}

986	// decodeJSONBody enforces the strict POST contract shared by every JSON
987	// endpoint: Content-Type must be application/json, the body is capped at
988	// maxBatchBytes, it must contain exactly one JSON value, and no trailing data
989	// may follow it. Any violation writes a 400 JSON error and returns false; the
990	// caller returns immediately, so no handler reaches the store with malformed
991	// input and rejected requests write nothing.
992	func decodeJSONBody(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, dst any) bool {
993		mediaType, _, err := mime.ParseMediaType(r.Header.Get("Content-Type"))
994		if err != nil || mediaType != "application/json" {
995			writeError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Content-Type must be application/json")
996			return false
997		}
998	
999		r.Body = http.MaxBytesReader(w, r.Body, maxBatchBytes)
1000		dec := json.NewDecoder(r.Body)
1001		if err := dec.Decode(dst); err != nil {
1002			writeError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid JSON body: "+err.Error())
1003			return false
1004		}
1005		// Reject trailing data after the JSON value.
1006		if err := dec.Decode(&struct{}{}); !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
1007			writeError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid JSON body: unexpected trailing content")
1008			return false
1009		}
1010		return true
1011	}

1425	// parseCursorPath reports whether raw is a decimal non-negative integer and
1426	// returns its value. Signs, fractions and other adornments are rejected.
1427	func parseCursorPath(raw string) (int64, bool) {
1428		if raw == "" {
1429			return 0, false
1430		}
1431		for _, c := range raw {
1432			if c < '0' || c > '9' {
1433				return 0, false
1434			}
1435		}
1436		n, err := strconv.ParseInt(raw, 10, 64)
1437		if err != nil {

1942	// expiry echoes the caller's cursor and never advances it. A client
1943	// disconnect simply stops the wait and writes nothing.
1944	func handlePollChanges(s *app.App, w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
1945		documentID := r.PathValue("documentID") // route pattern + guard guarantee non-empty
1946	
1947		after, limit, ok := parseChangesQuery(w, r)
1948		if !ok {
1949			return
1950		}
1951		waitMs, ok := parsePollWaitMs(w, r)
1952		if !ok {
1953			return
1954		}
1955	
1956		changes, nextCursor, timedOut, err := s.WaitForChanges(
1957			r.Context(), documentID, after, limit, time.Duration(waitMs)*time.Millisecond,
1958		)
1959		switch {
1960		case errors.Is(err, events.ErrStoreClosing):
1961			writeError(w, http.StatusServiceUnavailable, "service is shutting down")
1962			return
1963		case errors.Is(err, context.Canceled), errors.Is(err, context.DeadlineExceeded):
1964			// The client went away (or, with waitMs bounded, its deadline lapsed
1965			// at the transport): nothing more to write and nothing was stored.
1966			return
1967		case err != nil:
1968			writeError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "failed to poll changes")
1969			return
1970		}
1971	
1972		writePollPage(w, changes, nextCursor, timedOut)
1973	}
1974	
1975	// handleSessionPollChanges is the session-scoped long-poll continuation over
1976	// the same change collection the session reads page:
1977	//
1978	//	GET /v1/sessions/{sessionId}/documents/{documentId}/changes/poll
1979	//
1980	// The request is a GET with no body; the calling device is the session's
1981	// owning device resolved with the same identity rule as the session reads,
1982	// exports, commits and subscriptions. Query parameters and the success body are
1983	// identical to GET /v1/documents/{documentID}/changes/poll — after (default 0),
1984	// limit (default 100, 1..1000) and waitMs (default 0, 0..30000), answered with
1985	// changes, nextCursor and timedOut in that order, rows ascending by cursor.
1986	//
1987	// Rows already past after return immediately with timedOut=false; a known
1988	// document caught up to after parks until the first commit through any write
1989	// path (session batch commit, document commit, merge, restore, replay) or the
1990	// wait deadline; an unknown document returns an empty page with cursor 0 at
1991	// once and never parks. A deadline expiry returns the empty page, echoes the
1992	// caller's after and sets timedOut=true without advancing the cursor. Checks
1993	// run in the fixed order request shape and parameters (400), session
1994	// existence (404), document permission (403); a rejected request exposes no
1995	// change content. A client disconnect simply cancels the wait and writes
1996	// nothing; while the service is shutting down the parked request answers a
1997	// JSON 503.
1998	func handleSessionPollChanges(s *app.App, w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
1999		sessionID := r.PathValue("sessionId")   // route pattern + guard guarantee non-empty
2000		documentID := r.PathValue("documentId") // route pattern + guard guarantee non-empty
2001	
2002		// Parameter shape precedes the session lookup, matching the session paged
2003		// read's ordering: a malformed after/limit/waitMs against an unknown
2004		// session is still a 400.
2005		after, limit, ok := parseChangesQuery(w, r)
2006		if !ok {
2007			return
2008		}
2009		waitMs, ok := parsePollWaitMs(w, r)
2010		if !ok {
2011			return
2012		}
2013	
2014		deviceID, err := s.SessionDevice(sessionID)
2015		if err != nil {
2016			if errors.Is(err, store.ErrSessionNotFound) {
2017				writeError(w, http.StatusNotFound, "session not found")
2018				return
2019			}
2020			writeError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "failed to look up session")
2021			return
2022		}
2023	
2024		authorized, err := s.DocumentAuthorized(documentID, deviceID)
2025		if err != nil {
2026			writeError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "failed to look up permission")
2027			return
2028		}
2029		if !authorized {
2030			writeError(w, http.StatusForbidden, "device permission for this document has been revoked")
2031			return
2032		}
2033	
2034		changes, nextCursor, timedOut, err := s.WaitForChanges(
2035			r.Context(), documentID, after, limit, time.Duration(waitMs)*time.Millisecond,
2036		)
2037		switch {
2038		case errors.Is(err, events.ErrStoreClosing):
2039			writeError(w, http.StatusServiceUnavailable, "service is shutting down")
2040			return
2041		case errors.Is(err, context.Canceled), errors.Is(err, context.DeadlineExceeded):
2042			// The client went away (or, with waitMs bounded, its deadline lapsed
2043			// at the transport): nothing more to write and nothing was stored.
2044			return
2045		case err != nil:
2046			writeError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "failed to poll changes")
2047			return
2048		}
2049	
2050		writePollPage(w, changes, nextCursor, timedOut)
2051	}
2052	
2053	// handleReplay retries an offline batch against the existing change log. The
2054	// request and per-element semantics mirror POST .../changes — strict
2055	// application/json body, non-empty ids, no in-batch duplicates, idempotent only
2056	// when deviceId and decoded payload match, otherwise 409 reporting the
2057	// conflicting id — with the registration/permission layer enforced first:
2058	// 404 for an unregistered device and 403 for a revoked one, neither exposing
2059	// change content. The whole batch commits in one serialized transaction that
2060	// shares the document's contiguous cursor space with ordinary commits.
2061	func handleReplay(s *app.App, w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
2062		documentID := r.PathValue("documentID") // route pattern + guard guarantee non-empty
2063	
2064		var req replayRequest
2065		if !decodeJSONBody(w, r, &req) {
2066			return
2067		}
2068		if req.DeviceID == "" {
2069			writeError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "deviceId must be a non-empty string")
2070			return
2071		}
2072		if req.Operations == nil {
2073			writeError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "operations must be a non-empty array")
2074			return
2075		}
2076		if len(req.Operations) == 0 {
2077			writeError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "operations must be a non-empty array")
2078			return
2079		}
2080	
2081		changes := make([]events.Change, len(req.Operations))
2082		seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(req.Operations))
2083		for i, op := range req.Operations {
2084			if op.ID == "" {
2085				writeError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "each operation must have a non-empty string id")
2086				return
2087			}
2088			if len(op.Payload) == 0 {
2089				writeError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "each operation must carry a JSON payload")
2090				return
2091			}
2092			if _, dup := seen[op.ID]; dup {
2093				writeError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "duplicate operation id within batch: "+op.ID)
2094				return
2095			}
2096			seen[op.ID] = struct{}{}
2097			changes[i] = events.Change{ID: op.ID, DeviceID: req.DeviceID, Payload: op.Payload}
2098		}
2099	
2100		results, err := s.ReplayChanges(documentID, changes)
2101		if err != nil {
2102			var conflict *events.ErrConflict
2103			switch {
2104			case errors.Is(err, store.ErrDeviceNotFound):
2105				writeError(w, http.StatusNotFound, "device not found")
2106			case errors.Is(err, store.ErrPermissionDenied):
2107				writeError(w, http.StatusForbidden, "device permission for this document has been revoked")
2108			case errors.As(err, &conflict):
2109				writeJSON(w, http.StatusConflict, map[string]string{
2110					"error":      "operation id already exists with different deviceId or payload",
2111					"conflictId": conflict.ID,
2112				})
2113			default:
2114				writeError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "failed to replay operations")
2115			}
2116			return
2117		}
2118	
2119		writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{"results": results})
2120	}

1	// Package app is the composition root: it opens the one shared database and
2	// constructs the three independently reusable internal services — the change
3	// event service, the permission service and the CRDT state service — wiring
4	// them together only through their internal interfaces.
5	//
6	// The services share one SQLite connection (the kernel opens a single
7	// pooled connection with immediate transactions), so a change commit, a CRDT
8	// submission or compaction, and a permission change are serialized on the
9	// same connection and leave no half-written batch. The change event and CRDT
10	// services take their registration-and-authorization verdict from the
11	// permission service inside their own transactions (events.Gate / crdt.Gate),
12	// and the permission service fans a committed revoke out to their
13	// subscription registries through authz.RevokeSink. No service reaches into
14	// another service's tables or fields.
15	//
16	// App is the single object the entry and HTTP layers use. It promotes each
17	// service's input/output boundary as its methods while hiding the wiring; it
18	// adds no authentication and exposes no endpoint of its own.
19	package app
20	
21	import (
22		"context"
23		"encoding/json"
24		"time"
25	
26		"github.com/alicegogogogogo/local-first-sync-service/internal/authz"
27		"github.com/alicegogogogogo/local-first-sync-service/internal/crdt"
28		"github.com/alicegogogogogo/local-first-sync-service/internal/events"
29		"github.com/alicegogogogogo/local-first-sync-service/internal/push"
30		"github.com/alicegogogogogo/local-first-sync-service/internal/store"
31	)
32	
33	// App composes the durable kernel and the three internal services over one
34	// shared database connection.
35	type App struct {
36		*store.Store
37	
38		events *events.Service
39		crdt   *crdt.Service
40	
41		// pushSubs is the process-wide, in-memory registry of the live push
42		// connections across both channels. It backs the device-scoped
43		// subscription management endpoints and holds no durable state.
44		pushSubs *push.Registry
45	
46		// Authz is the permission service. It is exposed so the HTTP layer can
47		// grant/revoke and read authorization directly; the other services reach
48		// it through their gates rather than this field.
49		Authz *authz.Service
50	}
51	
52	// Open opens (creating if needed) the SQLite database at path and constructs
53	// every internal service over it. The empty path opens a private in-memory
54	// database useful for tests. A construction failure closes the kernel and
55	// leaves nothing behind.
56	func Open(path string) (*App, error) {
57		kernel, err := store.Open(path)
58		if err != nil {
59			return nil, err
60		}
61	
62		// The permission service is built first: its gate is a constructor
63		// dependency of the change event and CRDT services.
64		permissions, err := authz.New(kernel)
65		if err != nil {
66			_ = kernel.Close()
67			return nil, err
68		}
69		eventService, err := events.New(kernel, permissions)
70		if err != nil {
71			_ = kernel.Close()
72			return nil, err
73		}
74		crdtService, err := crdt.New(kernel, permissions)
75		if err != nil {
76			_ = kernel.Close()
77			return nil, err
78		}
79	
80		// A committed revoke ends the affected live subscriptions in both
81		// push channels. The dependency is an interface, registered once here, so
82		// the permission service never names either subscriber concretely.
83		permissions.AddRevokeSink(eventsRevokeSink{eventService})
84		permissions.AddRevokeSink(crdtService)
85	
86		return &App{
87			Store:    kernel,
88			events:   eventService,
89			crdt:     crdtService,
90			Authz:    permissions,
91			pushSubs: push.NewRegistry(),
92		}, nil
93	}
94	
95	// eventsRevokeSink adapts the change event service's revoke hook to the
96	// permission service's RevokeSink interface.
97	type eventsRevokeSink struct{ e *events.Service }

99	func (s eventsRevokeSink) PermissionRevoked(documentID, deviceID string) {
100		s.e.SignalRevoked(documentID, deviceID)
101	}

112	// InterruptWaits wakes every parked long poll and every live change-log and
113	// CRDT subscription without closing the database, so an orderly shutdown
114	// drains waiting connections (long polls answer 503; subscriptions finish
115	// with the going-away close) instead of holding the drain hostage.
116	func (a *App) InterruptWaits() {
117		a.events.InterruptWaits()
118		a.crdt.InterruptWaits()
119	}

126	// Close interrupts the in-memory observers, waits for every subscription
127	// handler to unregister and then releases the shared database handle.
128	func (a *App) Close() error {
129		a.events.InterruptWaits()
130		a.crdt.InterruptWaits()
131		a.events.WaitDrained()
132		a.crdt.WaitDrained()
133		return a.Store.Close()
134	}

301	// DeregisterDevice removes a registered device together with every record it
302	// owns — its sessions, the attachments it created (chunks, sealed state and
303	// unfinished uploads included), the access grants it held, and its
304	// document-permission rows — all in one serialized transaction that commits
305	// synchronously. An unknown or already deregistered device yields
306	// store.ErrDeviceNotFound and writes nothing, so a repeat deregistration
307	// misses exactly the way a never-registered id does and concurrent calls take
308	// effect at most once. Shared digest-addressed content is reclaimed only when
309	// the last completed attachment referencing it is gone; other devices'
310	// changes, snapshots and document content are untouched.
311	//
312	// After the commit the same id may register again as a brand-new device — no
313	// session, permission or attachment is inherited — and every live
314	// subscription the device held across both push channels is ended
315	// immediately, stickily.
316	func (a *App) DeregisterDevice(deviceID string) error {
317		tx, err := a.Store.DB().Begin()
318		if err != nil {
319			return err
320		}
321		defer func() { _ = tx.Rollback() }()
322	
323		if err := store.DeleteDeviceTx(tx, deviceID); err != nil {
324			return err
325		}
326		if err := a.Authz.DeleteDevicePermissionsTx(tx, deviceID); err != nil {
327			return err
328		}
329		if err := tx.Commit(); err != nil {
330			return err
331		}
332	
333		// End the device's live subscriptions only after the cascade is durable:
334		// a reconnect attempt after the close finds the backing session gone
335		// (404), so the connection cannot immediately re-establish itself.
336		a.events.SignalDeviceDeregistered(deviceID)
337		a.crdt.SignalDeviceDeregistered(deviceID)
338		return nil
339	}
340	
341	// ---- Document-level deletion. ----
342	
343	// DeleteDocument removes a registered device's whole document in one
344	// serialized, synchronously committed transaction. The calling device is
345	// declared by deviceId — no new authentication is introduced.
346	//
347	// The fixed verdict order is taken inside the transaction, before any cleanup:
348	//
349	//   - an unregistered device yields store.ErrDeviceNotFound (404) and writes
350	//     nothing;
351	//   - a device whose permission for the document was revoked yields
352	//     store.ErrPermissionDenied (403) and no cleanup runs;
353	//   - a document with no durable data anywhere — never created or already
354	//     deleted — yields events.ErrDocumentNotFound (404) and writes nothing.
355	//
356	// On success every row of the document is removed as one judgment: its online
357	// and trimmed change log, the retained idempotency summaries, its snapshots
358	// and named snapshot-version markers, its CRDT state and the per-document
359	// permission ledger. The same id is a brand-new document afterward — the
360	// cursor space restarts at 1 — and inherits no history or version names.
361	// Concurrent deletes commit at most once because the existence verdict and
362	// the deletions share one immediate transaction on the single connection.
363	//
364	// Only after the commit is durable are the document's live subscriptions
365	// ended (close code 4420 on both push channels) and dropped from the
366	// management registry; other documents' and devices' connections are
367	// untouched.
368	func (a *App) DeleteDocument(documentID, deviceID string) error {
369		tx, err := a.Store.DB().Begin()
370		if err != nil {
371			return err
372		}
373		defer func() { _ = tx.Rollback() }()
374	
375		// Registration first, then permission, both before any document content
376		// is observed: a rejected delete reveals nothing and cleans nothing.
377		if err := a.Authz.AuthorizedTx(tx, documentID, deviceID); err != nil {
378			return err
379		}
380	
381		eventsExist, err := a.events.DocumentDataExistsTx(tx, documentID)
382		if err != nil {
383			return err
384		}
385		crdtExist, err := a.crdt.DocumentDataExistsTx(tx, documentID)
386		if err != nil {
387			return err
388		}
389		// A ledger-only deviation row also counts as document data, so a document
390		// whose only durable trace is a grant/revoke still deletes cleanly and the
391		// re-created id inherits no authorization state.
392		ledgerExist, err := a.Authz.DocumentHasRowsTx(tx, documentID)
393		if err != nil {
394			return err
395		}
396		if !eventsExist && !crdtExist && !ledgerExist {
397			return events.ErrDocumentNotFound
398		}
399	
400		if err := a.events.DeleteDocumentDataTx(tx, documentID); err != nil {
401			return err
402		}
403		if err := a.crdt.DeleteDocumentDataTx(tx, documentID); err != nil {
404			return err
405		}
406		if err := a.Authz.DeleteDocumentPermissionsTx(tx, documentID); err != nil {
407			return err
408		}
409	
410		if err := tx.Commit(); err != nil {
411			return err
412		}
413	
414		// End the document's live subscriptions on both channels and drop them
415		// from the management registry only after the cleanup is durable: the
416		// close is one-shot per connection, so a client re-subscribing to the
417		// now-fresh id opens a new connection and never reopens the ended ones.
418		a.events.SignalDocumentDeleted(documentID)
419		a.crdt.SignalDocumentDeleted(documentID)
420		a.CloseDocumentPush(documentID)
421		return nil
422	}

- 返回 `200`，正文是一行紧凑 JSON 加末尾换行，顶层键按文档数组与条数的顺序固定出现：

  ```
  {"documents":[{"documentId":"document-1"},{"documentId":"document-2"}],"count":2}
  ```

- 清单列出该设备名下会话曾经写入过变更的文档：每条清单项只给出 `documentId` 一个字段；同一文档在一次结果里最多出现一次，并按文档标识的字典序升序排列（与写入先后无关）。`count` 给出本页条数，始终与数组长度一致。
- 分页在这一固定顺序上切片，参数口径与附件清单一致：`limit` 只接受 `1..1000` 的整数，缺省 `100`；`offset` 只接受非负整数，缺省 `0`，表示先跳过前面若干条。两次读取之间没有新增或删除时，翻页得到的条目不重不漏；越过末尾时返回空数组与零计数（`{"documents":[],"count":0}` 加换行），空清单照样返回 `200`，不是错误。
- 任一非法分页取值先于其他判定返回 `400` JSON 错误；设备未注册或已注销返回 `404` JSON 错误，且不返回任何清单内容。判定顺序固定为请求形状再到设备存在性，前序失败优先返回，失败一律零写入。
- 标识为空（连续斜杠或尾随斜杠）、段缺失或多余、方法不匹配一律返回 `400` JSON 错误，不重定向也不输出 HTML。取名 `documents` 的设备标识按普通标识处理，`documents` 这个词只在端点段位置才被识别为关键字。
- 清单是只读动作：不创建或删除文档与变更，也不占用变更游标或推送订阅。文档被整体删除、或其变更被全部压缩出在线日志后不再出现；设备注销期间其清单按未注册设备返回 `404`（注销不改动共享文档的变更日志，故同名设备重新注册后，其仍在在线日志里的历史变更所对应的文档仍会列出）。
- 重复请求与进程重启后，同一请求的正文逐字不变，读取不改动任何状态。本入口不改变变更提交、读取、压缩、合并、快照、恢复、CRDT、附件、会话与权限入口的既有语义。

### `GET /v1/devices/{deviceId}/subscriptions`

设备的订阅管理只读入口：列出该设备当前**活着**的全部推送订阅连接。路径上的 `deviceId` 就是调用者唯一身份，不新增任何认证机制；无请求体。

- 该设备经文档级订阅声明（查询参数 `deviceId`）建立的连接，以及经它名下会话建立的连接，都出现在列表里；增量变更订阅与 CRDT 状态订阅两种通道一并列出。
- 正文是一行紧凑 JSON 加末尾换行，顶层键按 `subscriptions`、`count` 的顺序固定出现：

  ```json
  {"subscriptions":[{"subscriptionId":"sub-1","documentId":"doc-a","kind":"changes","cursor":5,"establishedAt":1727000000000}],"count":1}
  ```

- 每条订阅固定给出五个字段且键序固定：`subscriptionId`（订阅标识，连接建立时由服务端分配，本进程内不重复，断开后不再出现于任何列表）、`documentId`（文档标识）、`kind`（通道种类：变更订阅为 `"changes"`，状态订阅为 `"state"`）、`cursor`（握手时请求的起始游标；状态订阅没有游标，这一项记 `0`）、`establishedAt`（连接建立时间，Unix 毫秒整数）。
- 全部条目按连接建立的先后升序排列，`count` 与数组长度始终一致。
- 列表是纯内存视图：客户端断开或进程重启后条目立即消失，不落盘、不写入任何记录，也不占用变更游标。没有任何存活订阅时照样返回 `200`，正文为 `{"subscriptions":[],"count":0}` 加换行——空列表不是错误。
- 调用设备未注册返回 `404` JSON 错误；路径标识为空（连续斜杠或尾随斜杠）、段缺失或多余、方法不匹配一律返回 `400` JSON 错误，不重定向也不输出 HTML。

### `DELETE /v1/devices/{deviceId}/subscriptions/{subscriptionId}`

设备的订阅主动回收入口：按订阅标识结束该设备名下指定的那一条存活连接。路径上的 `deviceId` 是唯一身份，无请求体。

- 成功返回一行 JSON：`200` `{"subscriptionId":"sub-1","deleted":true}` 加换行，不新增其他字段。
- 目标连接随即以关闭码 **4410** 结束并停止推送；同一文档的其他订阅方完全不受影响，后续提交照常推达。主动取消只结束目标连接：权限撤回仍以 `4403` 结束，终止信号仍以 `1001` 结束并零状态退出。
- 判定顺序固定为请求形状（`400`）→ 设备存在性（`404`）→ 订阅归属（`404`），前序失败优先返回；任何失败都不写入、不关闭其他连接。
- 订阅标识不存在、订阅已经断开、或属于其他设备，一律返回同一个 `404` JSON 错误，不泄露任何订阅内容；调用设备未注册同样返回 `404`。
- 路径标识为空（连续斜杠或尾随斜杠）、段缺失（如 `DELETE /v1/devices/{deviceId}/subscriptions`）或多余、方法不匹配一律返回 `400` JSON 错误，不重定向也不输出 HTML。
- 重复取消同一订阅同样返回 `404` 且不改变任何状态；失败响应不重定向也不输出 HTML。

### `GET /v1/sessions/{sessionId}/documents/{documentId}/changes`

会话视角的增量读取，查询参数与响应结构与 `GET /v1/documents/{documentID}/changes` 完全一致（`after`、`limit` 语义、`changes`/`nextCursor` 形状、未知文档返回空列表且 `nextCursor` 为 `0`）。

- `sessionId`、`documentId` 均为非空字符串；空段返回 `400` JSON 错误而非重定向。
- `after`、`limit` 非法返回 `400` JSON 错误（参数校验先于会话存在性检查）。
- 会话不存在或已删除返回 `404` JSON 错误；会话所属设备已被撤回该文档权限时返回 `403` JSON 错误，且不返回 `changes` 或 `nextCursor`；其余情况读取结果与既有 changes 查询逐字相同。

1	// Package events is the change event service: the durable per-document change
2	// log together with everything written on top of it.
3	//
4	// Within a document every change has a client-supplied id. New ids receive a
5	// monotonically increasing cursor; re-posting an existing id is idempotent
6	// only when the deviceId and decoded JSON payload match, otherwise it is a
7	// conflict. Valid batches commit atomically in one serialized transaction, so
8	// cursors never repeat and no record is partially written, even under
9	// concurrent writers. Ordinary posts, offline replays, merges and snapshot
10	// restores all allocate from the same per-document contiguous cursor space.
11	//
12	// A document may also carry snapshots: caller-supplied JSON states pinned to
13	// existing change cursors. Snapshots are write-once per cursor — a matching
14	// re-post is idempotent, a differing one a conflict — and live apart from the
15	// change log. A restore appends an ordinary change whose payload is a
16	// snapshot's state, recording its provenance so a repeated restore after a
17	// restart keeps the same idempotency/conflict decisions.
18	//
19	// Reads page by cursor in ascending order. The session view and the document
20	// view are the same read; the HTTP layer adds the session/permission checks.
21	// Long polling and push subscriptions are in-memory observers of commits:
22	// they register before the confirming read, hold no durable state, and are
23	// woken only after a change-bearing transaction has committed.

1	// Change-log compaction moves the old end of a document's change log out of
2	// the online tables without touching the cursor space the log shares with
3	// every write path.
4	//
5	// The compaction boundary is the greatest cursor that has a saved snapshot
6	// (zero when the document has none): everything at or below it is reproducible
7	// from a snapshot plus the surviving tail, so those rows leave the online log.
8	// A trimmed change is not forgotten, though — its id keeps a small canonical
9	// summary (the originating device, a digest of the payload and, for a restore,
10	// the snapshot it came from, plus the cursor it was first assigned) so the
11	// submission layer keeps answering idempotency and conflict exactly as before.
12	// The summary never participates in reads: pagination, long polling and
13	// subscriptions simply no longer see the trimmed rows, and the summary's
14	// fixed size means storage does not grow back to the pre-compaction shape.
15	//
16	// Compaction itself is not a change: it allocates no cursor, writes no change
17	// record and wakes no waiter or subscriber. The cursor space never resets —
18	// the next allocated cursor is one past the greater of the online maximum and
19	// the boundary — and the boundary, the summaries and the read results are
20	// durable across restarts.

170	}
171	
172	// boundaryOfTx returns the stored compaction boundary of documentID, or zero
173	// when the document was never compacted.
174	func boundaryOfTx(q store.DBTX, documentID string) (int64, error) {
175		var boundary int64
176		err := q.QueryRow(
177			`SELECT boundary FROM change_boundaries WHERE document_id = ?`,
178			documentID,
179		).Scan(&boundary)
180		switch {
181		case errors.Is(err, sql.ErrNoRows):
182			return 0, nil
183		case err != nil:
184			return 0, err
185		default:
186			return boundary, nil
187		}
188	}
189	
190	// currentCursorTx returns the document's high-water mark: the greatest online
191	// cursor, or the compaction boundary when every change up to it has left the
192	// online log. The cursor space never resets, so a fully trimmed document
193	// continues from its boundary rather than from zero.
194	func currentCursorTx(tx *sql.Tx, documentID string) (int64, error) {
195		var maxOnline int64
196		if err := tx.QueryRow(
197			`SELECT COALESCE(MAX(cursor), 0) FROM changes WHERE document_id = ?`,
198			documentID,
199		).Scan(&maxOnline); err != nil {
200			return 0, err
201		}
202		boundary, err := boundaryOfTx(tx, documentID)
203		if err != nil {
204			return 0, err
205		}
206		if boundary > maxOnline {
207			maxOnline = boundary
208		}
209		return maxOnline, nil
210	}
211	
212	// payloadDigest renders a payload in the canonical form JSONEqual compares —
213	// the decoded value re-encoded, so 1 and 1.0 or reordered object keys digest
214	// alike — and hashes it. The digest is the fixed-size stand-in for the payload
215	// in a trimmed change's retained summary.
216	func payloadDigest(payload json.RawMessage) ([]byte, error) {
217		var v any
218		if err := json.Unmarshal(payload, &v); err != nil {
219			return nil, err
220		}
221		canonical, err := json.Marshal(v)
222		if err != nil {
223			return nil, err
224		}
225		sum := sha256.Sum256(canonical)
226		return sum[:], nil
227	}
228	
229	// resolveTrimmedIdentity answers the submission question for an id whose
230	// online row is absent because compaction trimmed it. It returns found=true
231	// and the id's first cursor when the retained summary matches the incoming
232	// device and payload (an idempotent re-post), an *ErrConflict when a retained
233	// summary exists but differs, and found=false when no summary was retained (a
234	// genuinely new id).
235	func resolveTrimmedIdentity(tx *sql.Tx, documentID string, c Change) (found bool, cursor int64, err error) {
236		var device string
237		var digest []byte
238		err = tx.QueryRow(
239			`SELECT device_id, digest, cursor FROM change_identities WHERE document_id = ? AND id = ?`,
240			documentID, c.ID,
241		).Scan(&device, &digest, &cursor)
242		switch {
243		case errors.Is(err, sql.ErrNoRows):
244			return false, 0, nil
245		case err != nil:
246			return false, 0, err
247		}
248	
249		incoming, err := payloadDigest(c.Payload)
250		if err != nil {
251			return false, 0, err
252		}
253		if device != c.DeviceID || !bytes.Equal(digest, incoming) {
254			return false, 0, &ErrConflict{ID: c.ID}
255		}
256		return true, cursor, nil
257	}

+- 统计取数口径与文档清单一致：列出该设备名下会话曾经写入过变更、且当前仍留有在线变更的文档，同一文档在一次结果里最多出现一次，并按文档标识字典序升序排列。每条固定给出三个字段且键序固定：`documentId`（文档标识）、`changeCount`（仍留在在线日志里的变更条数）、`maxCursor`（这些在线变更中的最大游标）；条数与最大游标只统计仍留在在线日志里的变更，其他设备写入同一文档的变更不计入。`count` 给出本页条数，始终与数组长度一致。
+- 分页在这一固定顺序上切片，参数口径与文档清单一致：`limit` 只接受 `1..1000` 的整数，缺省 `100`；`offset` 只接受非负整数，缺省 `0`，表示先跳过前面若干条。两次读取之间没有新增或删除时，翻页得到的条目不重不漏；越过末尾时返回空数组与零计数（`{"pending":[],"count":0}` 加换行），空统计照样返回 `200`，不是错误。
+- 任一非法分页取值先于其他判定返回 `400` JSON 错误；设备未注册或未声明返回 `404` JSON 错误，且不返回任何统计内容。判定顺序固定为请求形状再到设备存在性，前序失败优先返回，失败一律零写入。

+- 统计是只读动作：不创建或删除文档与变更，也不占用变更游标或推送订阅。文档被整体删除、或其在线变更被清空后不再出现；部分压缩后条数与最大游标只反映仍留在在线日志中的变更；设备注销期间其统计按未注册设备返回 `404`（注销不改动共享文档的变更日志，故同名设备重新注册后，其仍在在线日志里的历史变更仍被统计）。
+- 重复请求与进程重启后，同一请求的正文逐字不变，读取不改动任何状态。本入口不改变变更提交、读取、压缩、合并、快照、恢复与 CRDT 入口的既有语义。
